title: Relief a Circle Membership Carries Against a Renew Business Asset Buyback Collection Charge
content:
The relief the profile's membership carries against a palletised collection charge on a Renew Business Asset Buyback agreement is read from the collections the membership tier includes in a year and from the haul-away credits already redeemed on the membership in the last twelve months. Both are read from what the profile holds under Northbeam Circle Membership: the hauls away the tier includes in a year, and the haul-away credit redemptions standing in the membership's own event history over the last twelve months. The collection floor against which the tier is measured is 4 hauls away in the year.

- Where the membership tier includes at least the collection floor of hauls away in the year and fewer haul-away credits than that have been redeemed on it in the last twelve months, the member collection relief of 55.00 USD is taken off the charge.
- Where the membership tier includes at least the collection floor of hauls away in the year and at least that many haul-away credits have been redeemed on it in the last twelve months, the member residual relief of 20.00 USD is taken off the charge.
- Where the profile holds no membership tier that includes that many hauls away in the year, no relief is taken off the charge.

**The two comparisons.** The first is the tier against the floor: a tier that includes 4 or more hauls away in the year is at or above the floor, and a tier that includes 3 or fewer is below it. The second is the redemptions against the tier's own figure, not against the floor: fewer redeemed than the tier includes gives the member collection relief, and as many redeemed as the tier includes, or more, gives the member residual relief.

| Hauls away the tier includes in a year | Haul-away credits redeemed in the last twelve months | Relief taken off |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 4 | 3 | 55.00 USD |
| 4 | 4 | 20.00 USD |
| 6 | 5 | 55.00 USD |
| 6 | 6 | 20.00 USD |
| 3 | any number | nothing |
| no membership tier held | — | nothing |

A tier that includes exactly 4 hauls away in the year is at the collection floor and so is not below it. Redemptions standing at exactly the number the tier includes are not fewer than that number, so the residual relief applies rather than the collection relief.
